result.instructions: Tools for NEURONwriter, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my NEURONwriter projects and their IDs."; "Create a content analysis for 'trail running shoes' in my project for google.co.uk."; "What terms and questions should my winter running shoe article cover?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes NEURONwriter data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run neuronwriter_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run neuronwriter_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run neuronwriter_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. neuronwriter_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: neuronwriter_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the NEURONwriter projects in the account, with each project ID, name, language and search engine. Start here to find a project ID. Uses no monthly analysis limit. API: POST /list-projects.

tools.name: neuronwriter_list_queries
tools.title: List queries
tools.description: List the content analyses (queries) inside one project, with status, keyword, language, engine and tags. Filter by status or tags to find ready analyses. Uses no monthly analysis limit. API: POST /list-queries.

project.description: Project ID: the last part of the project URL (app.neuronwriter.com/project/view/<id>). Get it from neuronwriter_list_projects.

source.description: Only queries created in the web app (neuron) or by the API (neuron-api).

keyword.description: Only queries with this main keyword.

engine.description: Search engine, for example google.co.uk or google.com.

tags.description: Only queries with this tag, or with all of these tags when given as a list.

tools.name: neuronwriter_get_query
tools.title: Get query recommendations
tools.description: Get the status of one analysis and, when status is 'ready', its recommendations: metrics (word count, readability), content terms, questions, and the SERP competitors. A new analysis takes about 60 seconds; if status is 'waiting' or 'in progress', call again later. Uses no monthly analysis limit. API: POST /get-query.

query.description: Query ID: the 'query' field returned by neuronwriter_create_query or neuronwriter_list_queries.

tools.name: neuronwriter_get_content
tools.title: Get saved content
tools.description: Get the last content revision saved in the NEURONwriter editor for one query: HTML body, title, meta description, revision date and type. Choose revision_type 'all' to include autosave revisions. Uses no monthly analysis limit. API: POST /get-content.

query.description: Query ID: the 'query' field returned by neuronwriter_create_query or neuronwriter_list_queries.

revision_type.description: 'manual' (default) returns manually saved revisions; 'all' also returns autosaves.

tools.name: neuronwriter_evaluate_content
tools.title: Score a draft
tools.description: Score a draft article (HTML or a public URL) against the query's recommendations, without saving it. Use it to check a draft before importing it. Give html or url. Saves nothing and creates no revision. API: POST /evaluate-content.

query.description: Query ID: the 'query' field returned by neuronwriter_create_query or neuronwriter_list_queries.

html.description: Draft article HTML. Give html or url.

url.description: Public URL of the article to fetch and score. Give html or url.

title.description: Article title. Overrides the title found in the HTML or the URL.

description.description: Meta description. Overrides the description found in the HTML or the URL.

container_id.description: Only with url: the id of the HTML element that holds the article.

container_class.description: Only with url: the class of the HTML element that holds the article.

tools.name: neuronwriter_create_query
tools.title: Create a content analysis
tools.description: Create a new content analysis for one keyword in a project. It uses one analysis from the account's monthly limit. Recommendations are ready after about 60 seconds: call neuronwriter_get_query with the returned query ID. API: POST /new-query.

project.description: Project ID: the last part of the project URL (app.neuronwriter.com/project/view/<id>). Get it from neuronwriter_list_projects.

keyword.description: The keyword to analyse, for example 'trail running shoes'.

engine.description: Search engine, for example google.co.uk or google.com.

competitors_mode.description: Competitor set: top10 (default), top30, or top-intent (pages that match the dominant search intent).

tools.name: neuronwriter_import_content
tools.title: Save draft content
tools.description: Save article content into the NEURONwriter editor of one query as a new revision. Give html or url; with url, NEURONwriter fetches and parses the page. This writes to the user's editor content. API: POST /import-content.

query.description: Query ID: the 'query' field returned by neuronwriter_create_query or neuronwriter_list_queries.

html.description: Article HTML to save. Give html or url.

url.description: Public URL of the article to fetch and save. Give html or url.

title.description: Article title. Overrides the title found in the HTML or the URL.

description.description: Meta description. Overrides the description found in the HTML or the URL.

container_id.description: Only with url: the id of the HTML element that holds the article.

container_class.description: Only with url: the class of the HTML element that holds the article.

prompts.name: score_a_draft_before_you_save_it

prompts.description: Score a draft, given as HTML or as a public URL, against an analysis. The check saves nothing.

prompts.name: start_an_analysis_for_a_keyword
prompts.title: Start an analysis for a keyword
prompts.description: Create an analysis for one keyword in a project. Its recommendations are ready after about 60 seconds.

prompts.name: read_the_last_saved_draft
prompts.title: Read the last saved draft
prompts.description: Get the last content revision saved in the editor for one analysis. Include the autosave revisions if you need them.

prompts.name: save_a_draft_into_the_editor
prompts.title: Save a draft into the editor
prompts.description: Save article HTML or a page URL as a new revision in the editor of one analysis. Then read the saved content.
